subject: Request for latest security assessment — secure transfer options
messages:
From: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@starlight-health.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@starlight-health.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest security assessment — secure transfer options

Hi Markus / Irene,

We're in the middle of a SIG questionnaire for a new customer pilot and need a copy of Redwood's most recent security assessment for your hosted API (executive summary + full technical report if possible). A few quick asks from our compliance team:

- Can you confirm the scope (which environments and services were tested)?
- Does the full report include remediation timelines or a tracker?
- What secure transfer options do you support for delivering the full report (SFTP, encrypted presigned S3, secure evidence portal)?

If possible, we prefer SFTP or an ephemeral presigned S3 link that expires after download. We also need the report by EOD in 3 business days if that's feasible.

Thanks — if there's a short SLA/PO required to release the full report, let us know and we'll route it internally.

Best,
Michael Barnes
Senior Security Analyst
Starlight Health
--
On Wed, Jul 14, 2027 at 08:05 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> (Internal note: keeping sec looped)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@starlight-health.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest security assessment — secure transfer options

Hi Michael — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help. Quick answers up front and next steps below.

Scope summary:
- Tested scope: Redwood hosted API (production and staging clusters backing Hosted API endpoints).
- Explicitly out of scope: Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Private/VPC on-prem bundles — those are separate engagements.

Report contents and remediation:
- We can share a redacted executive summary within 24 hours.
- The full technical report and raw findings can be provided; we include a remediation tracker with planned/actual dates for each finding.

Secure delivery options we support:
- SFTP to a customer-hosted endpoint (preferred for large packages)
- Ephemeral presigned S3 (HTTPS) links with password-protected ZIP for added protection
- Access to our evidence portal (Drive folder + per-user token) for compliance reviewers

Attachments I can send immediately:
- Executive_Summary_redacted_2027.pdf (no PII, high-level findings) — I will attach this to my next message.

For the full report we typically require an NDA or DPA to be in place; if you already have a signed DPA on file we can proceed to the secure transfer. If there are any procurement PO constraints, let me know and we'll work with your team.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 15-minute call to confirm the scope and agree on the delivery mechanism — I can be available this afternoon.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Executive_Summary_redacted_2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@starlight-health.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-ops@starlight-health.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest security assessment — secure transfer options

Thanks Markus — that helps. Two clarifying points from our side before you upload anything: 

1) Scope: can you explicitly confirm whether the report includes credentialed (authenticated) testing against the Hosted API endpoints, or if it was strictly unauthenticated/black-box? We need that called out in the SIG.

2) Deliverables: we'd like the remediation tracker as a machine-readable CSV so we can ingest it into our GRC tool. Can you include a file like remediation-tracker-Redwood_2027.csv alongside the report?

SFTP is fine for us — please tell us if you need a public key or if you'll provide temporary credentials. We'll share the target host and preferred username after you confirm.

If you can include the executive summary now and indicate ETA for the CSV + full report, we can mark the request as 'in progress' internally.

Best,
Michael

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@starlight-health.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest security assessment — secure transfer options

Hi Michael — looping in operations details and next steps.

Summary of what we'll provide and timing:
- Executive summary (redacted) — attached to this thread (see file list). Available immediately.
- Full technical report + remediation tracker (CSV) — we will upload to a temporary SFTP drop within 48 hours after we confirm transfer method. Expected delivery: by EOD 2027-07-17.

SFTP transfer instructions (one-time config):
- Host: sftp.redwood-secure.com
- Port: 22
- Username: starlight_sftp_mbarnes
- One-time password: [will be sent via separate SMS or our inline secure form]
- If you prefer key-based auth, reply with a public key and we will whitelist it and create the account.

Files that will be uploaded to the SFTP root (starlight_sftp_mbarnes):
- Redwood_Inference_PenTest_Summary_2027.pdf (full technical report, redactions applied where necessary)
- remediation-tracker-Redwood_2027.csv (machine-readable; columns: finding_id,severity,status,remediation_target,remediation_actual)
- README_transfer_instructions.txt (transfer checklist and verification steps)

On scope: the July 2027 engagement included both unauthenticated (black-box) and credentialed (authenticated) testing of the Hosted API surface; the test plan and methodology are documented in the appendix of the full report. We'll call that out explicitly in the README and the CSV so your SIG responses can reference the correct sections.

Security note: presigned links will be rotated after first successful download. If you need longer access windows or a different mechanism (e.g., access to our evidence portal with time-limited tokens), we can arrange that — let us know.

I'll upload the files to SFTP and then reply with a short confirmation message including a checksum and a link to the drive folder for your auditors.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Inference_PenTest_Summary_2027.pdf (pdf); remediation-tracker-Redwood_2027.csv (csv); README_transfer_instructions.txt (txt)]
